systemLimitSerial: wslc tolerates only one call at a time; this app serializes calls for you.
systemLimitRestartPolicy: pause/unpause and the unless-stopped / on-failure restart policies are not supported yet.
systemLimitVolumes: A WSL session mounts at most about 15 volumes; beyond that it reports “Too many volumes have been mounted”. Reset with wsl --shutdown.
systemLimitLoopback: Published ports bind to the Windows loopback address, so test them from Windows (browser / Invoke-WebRequest).
systemElevation: Terminals with different elevation levels (normal / administrator) have separate wslc sessions, and containers, images, networks and volumes are not visible across them.

updateUnsupportedHint: Development builds, and copies in a folder that can't be written to (such as Program Files), can't update themselves. Download new versions from the GitHub releases page.
updateCheckTooltip: Look for a new version online. If there is one, a window shows what changed.
settingsAutoCheckUpdatesHint: Checks about 10 seconds after launch, then once a day, and tells you when a new version is out.
settingsAutoInstallUpdatesHint: Downloads new versions in the background and installs them at the next launch, without asking.
vmMemoryTooltip: Memory the virtual machine holds on Windows. It is the {process} process in Task Manager, not usage inside the containers.
vmStartTooltip: Start the wslc virtual machine. The first start takes a few seconds.
vmStopTooltip: Stop the virtual machine and every container running in it.
vmHint: Containers, images, volumes and networks live in this virtual machine. With no container running, it shuts itself down after a period of idleness (30 seconds by default); to change that, set session.idleTimeout in the wslc settings.
vmStopConfirmBody: No container is running in the virtual machine. You can start it again here at any time.
vmStopConfirmBodyRunning: This stops every running container in the virtual machine ({count}): {names}. Containers and images are kept; you can start the containers again later.
vmPaneTitle: The virtual machine is not running
vmPaneBody: Containers, images, volumes and networks live in the virtual machine, so it has to be started before you can see them. With no container running, it shuts itself down again after a period of idleness (30 seconds by default).
vmDetectBroken: The virtual machine started, but its process cannot be found on Windows, so status detection is turned off.
composeNewDirHint: Must not exist or be empty; defaults to a directory under your scan root. No existing file is ever overwritten.
composeNewDirBrowse: Pick a parent directory; the project directory is created inside it
composeNewTooltip: Create a compose project from scratch
composeNewComposeHint: Written to <directory>/compose.yaml; the YAML syntax is checked first.
composeNewEnvHint: Written to <directory>/.env and referenced from compose.yaml by variable name. Leave it empty to skip the file.
